caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with a gothic-style design featuring four pointed spires, two on each side, and a steeply pitched central roof section. The surface of the clock is rendered to mimic a rich brown wood grain. The clock face is positioned in the upper portion of the structure and is circular with black Roman numerals on a white background and black clock hands. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular panel with a painted image of a blue bowl holding a bouquet of colorful flowers, including pink, blue, and white blossoms with green leaves. Beneath this panel is another larger rectangle bordered with green, and within this space is an oval-shaped painting depicting a brown and white dog lying down on a white surface. The base of the clock is rectangular with four small round feet. The background is plain and unadorned, with a pale neutral tone. Near the bottom left, the name "LORENZ ROTHKRANZ" is inscribed in small, simple letters.
title: Shelf Clock
